# 2.17.0

- Add live permissions, token/auth events and connection health to the service client scaffold.
  Refresh role facades without UI polling and retain view Store identity across revoke/regrant.
- Guard role projections, catch-up history and saved commands against current local permissions;
  isolate protected shared content per session while retaining shared public lines.
- Renew ready tokens through authority; keep external issuers explicit and stop automatically
  logging in after failed renewal. Clear private mirrors on expiry/revocation.
- Reuse session resources on reauth; cancel pending permissions, handshakes, refreshes and timers
  on close. Regenerate pizzeria, rental, apartments and small-jobs access/client templates.
- Reload permissions and clear previous private data when an external issuer changes the account.
- Verify independent access, multiple raw socket sessions, second-node regrant, short-token renewal,
  account ban and close races; retain the pizzeria crash/archive/receipt checks from 2.16.1.

Deploy updated client and server scaffolds together. `shared: true` now shares content semantics,
not private subscription ownership; role projections recheck every source batch even with `keys`.
A view's `ready` waits for its first permitted keyframe, then remains settled across later role
changes; observe permissions separately. Revocation on replicas is delayed by replication and
partitions. No new dependencies, React bindings, domain rules or low-level RPC/replay changes.
